import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict[str, "pandas.DataFrame"]) -> dict[str, "pandas.DataFrame"]:
    df = inputs["RATE_FEED"].copy()

    # Legacy cursor order: ORDER BY account_id, obs_date, obs_seq
    df = df.sort_values(
        by=["account_id", "obs_date", "obs_seq"],
        kind="mergesort",  # stable sort to mimic deterministic cursor traversal
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    # Carry-forward last non-null rate, but never across account boundaries.
    # groupby().ffill() naturally resets at each group (account_id) boundary,
    # exactly matching the cursor's prev_acct reset logic.
    filled_rate = df.groupby("account_id")["rate"].ffill()

    # was_carried = 1 only when the original rate was NULL AND a prior
    # (same-account) rate was available to carry forward.
    was_carried = (df["rate"].isna() & filled_rate.notna()).astype("int64")

    result = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "account_id": df["account_id"],
            "obs_seq": df["obs_seq"],
            "obs_date": df["obs_date"],
            "rate_filled": filled_rate,
            "was_carried": was_carried,
        }
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    return {"rate_filled": result}
